title: Audit: P111 Parseval blocks cost 73 in the fixed-block scalar model
body:
## Result: an exact fixed-block scalar-copy obstruction

This independently audits PR #1900 at `9a891c9cb25b15f5a189bcad1d022198adeaf885`. Its **F2 Parseval identity is valid**: reconstruction agrees on all 111 targets and all 661 formal dirty input columns. This is not the complex-field issue in #1889.

The new question is the copy interface. Within each of #1900's five fixed rank-two coefficient blocks, allow any finite sum of inherited scalar copied totals, with factors in that block's two-dimensional binary source and target spans. All basis choices, asymmetric terms and repeated terms are allowed; cross-block rebasing and new operator-valued primitives are not.

The exact block minima are **16, 15, 14, 14, 14**, totaling **73**, versus **74** for the literal ten-channel Parseval expansion and **63** for the selected nine scalar channels. Every finite word reduces by parity to a subset of nine possible rank-one terms: the verifier checks all **2,560 subsets**, the **160 exact factorizations**, and all **30 ordered GL2(F2) bases**. Rational pairing ranks are independently cross-checked by modular elimination on the full Gram support matrices.

The sum of five union-support ranks is indeed 40, but it is **not the invoice of five ordinary scalar copies implementing these rank-two blocks**. Literal one-copy-per-union substitution gives 5,838 wrong source entries and 17,146 wrong full dirty entries. With source port 0 equal to one and all other inputs zero, target 0 receives zero instead of one. The package includes this counterexample and 45 two-bit single-channel witnesses.

**Scope is essential:** this is not a proof that a genuinely new physical block-valued copy must cost two scalar copies, nor a disproof of a possible plane-port supplier. The coefficient planes do not themselves provide physical data-port planes or justify `unpaid=2`. The all-length scalar P111 optimum 63 is credited predecessor work; the new result is the exact pinned five-block audit and its typed-interface counterexamples.

## Favorable paid screen

Keeping the incumbent non-copy children and line-port contract, the best fixed-block scalar interpretation replaces two rank-7 copies by three rank-8 copies. With every *additional* basis, routing, storage, restoration, hosting and precision charge optimistically zero, its exact ceiling is `a <= 0.001401325233`, compared with the original line relaxation `a <= 0.001947467559`. This screen does not treat omitted implementation charges as free in a completed construction. No new supplier, selected frontier, or kappa is claimed.

## Verification

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -O -B research/p111-parseval-copy-interface/verify.py
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/p111-parseval-copy-interface
```

Observed locally on CPython **3.12.12**, Darwin arm64:

```text
PASS_P111_PARSEVAL_COPY_INTERFACE blocks=5 subsets=2560 factorizations=160 dirty_columns=661 copy_min=73 baseline=63 union_failure_entries=17146
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p111-parseval-copy-interface outcome=negative-result
```

An isolated optimized generator smoke and registered replay passed. Positive controls preserve the original and Parseval dirty maps. Negative controls cover every one-channel choice, ten optimal-term omissions, a broken frame, omitted block, switched channels, and rational-versus-binary rank. The first metadata wrapper attempt rejected an invalid outcome enum; it was corrected before the successful registered replay. A second agent independently reviewed the scoped proof and ran the registered Python 3.12 replay before publication. No human proof review, full selected cold replay, or unseen CI result is claimed.

## Provenance and changed files

Only `research/p111-parseval-copy-interface/` is added: README, exact RESULT, complete independently emitted SELECTION, SOURCE-CLAIM, TASK, SOURCES, VERIFY and standalone verifier. No frozen input or selected frontier is changed.

- Independently sampled seed: `3cc9f4c8f3719f13f4ae6bf28c9ba982`.
- Track: `recursive-interfaces`; task: `coverage-law-change`, explicitly changed to the active typed-interface audit.
- Exact baseline: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`.
- [Round-two claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1929#discussioncomment-18925833); [physical plane handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-18925111).
- Final targeted live search found #1900 only for Parseval and no open blockwise-copy audit; its head remains pinned above. Search results are not a novelty proof.
